title: PrepSolutions 2-Way Grate & Measure – Multi-Function Grater for Shredding, Slicing & Measuring
description:
About this item
Contains (1) Prep Solutions by Progressive 2-Way Grate & Measure
Grate & Measure in One: Grate cheese, vegetables, chocolate, and more with the 2-Way Grate & Measure, featuring a removable, no-mess measuring container with easy-to-read markings
Ergonomic & Convenient: Grate directly into the 2-cup capacity container, which stores neatly inside the grater, making food prep quicker and easier.
Dishwasher Safe & Stylish: Designed for functionality and style, this grater is dishwasher safe and offers space-saving storage, ideal for everyday meal prep.
PrepSolutions provides practical and efficient kitchen tools designed to make meal prep and storage easier. Our products combine innovative design, durability, and convenience for every home cook.

reviews_5s:
I like this grater for two reasons -

1. It's designed to lay on it's side. So many of these box graters only work in a vertical position and that's where I normally lose a finger tip.

2. It grates in two directions. Most graters only grate one way. this one grate two ways so you can grate with a back and forth movement the works faster.

It's just a better idea.Perfect grater! Easy to use and to clean. We’ll built. Grates in both directions. Love it!I used the first one often, and for YEARS. The finer side is the perfect size for Parmesan, and the whole thing can be wrapped for storage if you're feeling a tad lazy. Also, the cutting surfaces let you grate in both directions. Just fabulously useful.Such a cool little grater. The cheese receptacle makes it so convenient!The blades on this thing are seriously sharp. It glides through cheese like butter, making quick work of even the hardest blocks. No more struggling or ending up with mangled cheese!BuenoThis grater provided the perfect solution. My husband likes to get in and help, but struggles to manipulate the normal graters. This grater's design, and ease of use, created gave that support to make helping in the kitchen possible.I've been without a grater for several years, mostly because I thought I didn't need one. I have a small microplane, but it doesn't work on cheese or larger amounts of chocolate, etc. My food processor can be used, but it's a lot of trouble for small tasks, so I mostly chopped cheese and such with a knife.

It seems graters have been greatly improved, if judged by this one. I used it the other day for the first time to shred cheese and was happily surprised by how little physical effort was needed. It doesn't slip on the countertop and the clip on container is very handy for measuring and keeping the grated material all in one place.

The shredder appears to be well made and washes up easily. If you need a hand grater, choose this one - I think you'll be pleased...I saw this grater on YouTube and since I wasn’t happy with the one I had, I decided to give it a try. It works great. It easy to use and cleaning is easy. It was just what I needed.As descried would order again
reviews_1s: I received the item in damage condition.There was no plastic container as advertised, just a rubber bottom. Totally disappointed. It was a gift and I only just realized it was not as advertised.I used this once, and I had to use great force to get my cheese to grate. It was fresh cheese, not hard or dried out. When my son-in-law came over for dinner and felt the grating holes, he said it was pathetic. The only thing it is good for is a stage prop.The bass relief (dimples) that do the cutting are too shallow resulting in a poor shredding.. That's the problem when ordering things online. You can't tell that from the pictures. My shreddings are too small. I will try to give this away to someone as it is useless to me. Grating up and down, as this is designed, is not advantageous for me. It's awkward. It's a gimmick. A one way grater is easier to clean as you can wipe it in the non-cutting direction. I hate this grater.The holes are too small to grate cheese. I like the concept but it is not a good cheese grater. Don't buy.I didn't get to use it, because it arrived broken.This grater is not sharp enough to make grating easy.While it looks like a good idea its terrible. All the cheese sticks to the metal and you can even sprinkle it on salad.Doesn't do a good job of grating and takes longer than my old box grater.As the holes are too small, it makes puree from your food....hated it.
